title: Site Engineer - Civil
summary: A civil site engineer makes sure a building, road or plant is built as drawn, safely and to quality. They work on the construction site under a project or senior engineer, supervising contractors and labour, checking concrete and steel work, and reporting daily progress.
dailyDuties: Check shuttering, reinforcement and levels against structural drawings before a concrete pour
Witness slump tests and cast cubes for compressive strength testing
Supervise contractors and labour gangs on the day's work
Write the daily progress report and update site registers
Calculate quantities of concrete and steel needed for the next activities
Run toolbox talks and check PPE and scaffolding safety
Raise drawing queries with the design team

skills.expectation: Read structural and architectural drawings and check work against them
Supervise RCC, shuttering, reinforcement and finishing work on site
Carry out or witness cube, slump and other material tests
Apply IS 456 and related codes to concrete work
Use an auto level or total station to set out and check levels
Work out quantities of concrete, steel and other materials from drawings
Write daily progress reports and keep site records
Follow and enforce basic site safety such as PPE and work-at-height rules
Coordinate with supervisors, contractors and the project manager
Plan daily work with labour gangs and subcontractors
Check bar bending schedules before steel is cut
Open and mark up drawings in AutoCAD
Track quantities and progress in Excel
